ns2:course.label: Principles of Composition
ns2:course.description: Study of the methods of exposition, the problems of argument, the use of evidence, and style; practice in expository writing. This course fulfills the Campus Composition I general education requirement. Credit is not given for both RHET 105 and any of these other Comp I courses: RHET 101, RHET 102, RHET 103, RHET 104, CMN 111 or CMN 112.
